paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates how the metric labeled “minADE\_20 (←)” varies with the “Number of Examples,” comparing two methods shown in the legend: “ST-ES” and “Random.” The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 8, with labeled ticks at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 (data markers appear at each integer value). The y-axis is labeled “minADE\_20 (←),” uses a linear scale, and covers values roughly from about 0.123 up to about 0.141, with labeled ticks shown at approximately 0.13 and 0.14 (and intermediate gridlines between them). The ST-ES series is drawn as a blue solid line with circular markers; it starts near 0.139 at 0 examples, drops to about 0.127 at 1, reaches its lowest point around 0.124 at 2 and about 0.123 at 4, then rises to about 0.128 by 6–7 and ends near 0.128 at 8. The Random series is drawn as an orange solid line with circular markers; it begins near 0.140 at 0 examples, decreases to about 0.132 at 1–3, increases to around 0.135 at 4 and about 0.137 at 5, dips to roughly 0.131 at 6, then increases again to about 0.137 at 7 and ends near 0.139 at 8.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates minADE\_20 performance (with a left-pointing arrow in the label) as a function of the number of in-context examples, comparing two selection methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 8 with ticks shown at regular intervals (0, 2, 4, 6, 8). The y-axis is labeled “minADE\_20 (←),” uses a linear scale, and ranges approximately from about 0.126 to 0.14 (tick labels are shown around the 0.13–0.14 region). Two solid lines with circular markers are shown: the ST-ES series is a blue solid line with blue circle markers, starting near 0.139 at 0 examples, dropping to about 0.129 at 1 example and to roughly 0.127 at 2 examples, reaching a low point around 0.126–0.127 near 4 examples, then rising to about 0.129–0.130 around 6–7 examples and ending near 0.129–0.130 at 8 examples. The Random series is an orange solid line with orange circle markers, starting near 0.14 at 0 examples, dropping to about 0.132 at 1 example, staying around roughly 0.132–0.133 at 2–3 examples, increasing to about 0.134 at 4 examples and about 0.136 at 5 examples, dipping to around 0.131 at 6 examples, then increasing again to about 0.136–0.137 at 7 examples and ending near 0.138–0.139 at 8 examples.
